description: This file defines a PHP class EmployeeAllowedLanguageSearchFilterParams, which extends FilterParams to provide filtering parameters specifically for employee language data searches within the OrangeHRM system. It primarily manages the employee number and includes sorting capabilities.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedLanguageSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object class for specifying search filter parameters related to employee language permissions, including sorting and employee number filtering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameter object and sets the default sort field to 'l.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the filter, or null if not set.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for filtering purposes.
